title: Put the CodeAnt inspection inside the thing that merges
head: 40d1b56

gates_executed_individually.measured_from: run 31386890875 job steps, not from the three aggregate check names

not_executed.lockfile: declared blocking, never wired to a step. The workflow uses `uv sync --frozen`, which SKIPS the lock check rather than performing it. ci/check_workflow_integrity.py warns about this and it is unchanged from main, so it is not a regression introduced here.
not_executed.cached-mutation: parked 2026-08-08 and documented in ci/gates.toml. A cached pytest-gremlins verdict carries no selected_tests; full-mutation and mutation-accounting still run on every authoritative path.

codeant_findings.claim: The final head check is not atomic with the merge. A push between read_head_sha and the merge call means GitHub may merge a newer, unreviewed head.
codeant_findings.fix: --match-head-commit <inspected sha> passed to the merge, so the comparison happens inside the merge on the server. The local check is kept because it produces the readable refusal.
codeant_findings.mutation: Removing the flag turns 2 tests red.

codeant_findings.claim: reviews_on_head treats every review at the head as authorisation, ignoring `state`. A DISMISSED or PENDING review therefore authorises a merge.
codeant_findings.fix: Restricted to APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED and COMMENTED. CodeAnt writes COMMENTED.
codeant_findings.mutation: Removing the state filter turns 2 tests red. A third test is the control, so narrowing to the empty set cannot pass by rejecting everything.

codeant_reanchoring: Both comments sit on 8601278 with line=null after the rebase - GitHub marks them outdated. Each fix was verified against source at 40d1b56 rather than against comment metadata.
also_carried: One .github line: claude.yml's SHA pin comment corrected from # v1 to # v1.0.187 after Anthropic moved the floating v1 tag. The SHA is unchanged. Without it zizmor's ref-version-mismatch audit fails workflow-security on every branch.
local_verification: 2544 passed, 5 xfailed. ruff clean. pyright 0 errors.
